name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, hands-on course that takes you from zero to actually shipping an AI product, step by step.
buyer: An aspiring AI engineer or founder who wants to learn by building, not just watching lectures.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp uses the curriculum as free course material and sells paid mentorship/cohort support on top.
A corporate L&D team assigns it as internal AI upskilling material for engineers.
A career coach packages it into a paid 'AI engineer in 90 days' program with accountability check-ins.

money_ideas.idea: Sell paid cohort-based mentorship/office hours layered on top of this free curriculum.
Offer a paid 'certificate of completion + portfolio review' add-on for learners who finish it.

steal_this: Launch a $49 'accountability cohort' this week where learners work through this free curriculum together with weekly check-ins.
